notice.pluginInvalid: The layer “{name}” cannot be loaded: the plugin package is invalid.
notice.pluginIncompatible: The layer “{name}” requires plugin API version {required}, but the program provides version {provided}. The layer was not loaded.
notice.pluginDuplicate: The layer “{name}” is already loaded. The second copy of the plugin was skipped.
notice.pluginFailed: The layer “{name}” stopped working because of an error in its plugin. Other layers keep working, and the data of this layer will be kept when saving.
notice.layerBroken: The layer “{name}” was marked as broken after an error in its plugin. Other layers keep working, and the data of this layer will be kept when saving.
notice.shortcutConflict: The shortcut {keys} of the layer “{name}” is already taken and was not assigned.
